_about: Every window in the game and the painted picture it gets (pictures/08, the parent's note [#23.33]: every window needs a generated picture). tools/art_list.py adds these rows to ART_LIST.csv, after the window style prompt. A window picture is a full-bleed painted scene shown on top of the window, like the story pictures (not a sprite on white). Picture rules: the farmer is never painted (R3; here not even a hand: the window is seen through the farmer's eyes), no words or numbers in the picture, a named person only where the brief says so (their look: art-inbox/Story pictures/canon-for-pictures.md). One picture per window that suits every stage of its place, so upgrades never make it wrong. Generate several windows per sheet (2x2 panels), most-seen first (priority). `opens` says where the window is in the game; `noPicture` lists the windows that keep their own content picture instead.
style: Painted full-bleed scene for the top of a window in a children's farming game: bright, friendly bold cartoon like the farm's sprites (thick rounded dark outlines, flat colours, simple cel shading, warm soft daylight), seen from eye height as if standing there, filling the whole frame edge to edge in a wide landscape format (3:2), the main thing in the middle with nothing important at the edges; green late spring, no snow; no text, no letters, no numbers (signs and labels blank); no farmer, no player character, no hands of the viewer; people only where the prompt asks for them, small and friendly.
